current_week_rule: Manual. The teacher explicitly selects exactly one current week in Planner; calendar dates never change it automatically.

visibility_levels.meaning: Safe for the public student agenda and public course repository.
Safe for the co-teacher and private shared repository, including assessment links, teacher guides, and answer keys.
Personal/local tools and data that must never be copied into the shared teacher repository.

teacher_view_rules: Read-only: no Planner controls and no links into local Teacher Tools.
Show the same manually selected current week and All Weeks history as the student agenda.
Show the exact student-facing resources actually used on each day.
Add up to three teacher-only rows per day for teacher guides, assessments, answer keys, and other teacher-shared artifacts.
Quick Check and Summative Assessment remain display-only for students while their assessment links appear in teacher-only rows when registered.
Never include student names, grades, evidence reports, or other student data.
